body.x: PALSOO (CEO Palsoo Jang) participated in the 'Startup Zone' at the Eureka Park K-STARTUP integrated hall of 'CES 2023' in Las Vegas, USA from January 5 (Thursday) to 8 (Sunday, local time) for a total of 4 days.

The company is working on developing an environmentally-friendly and pesticide-free, pest-control plasma products for drones and plans to file a patent. PALSOO’s missions are developing technology that helps to maintain a clean production environment while improving efficiency throughout the process of growing and distributing agricultural products as well as providing a life-friendly and customer-friendly plasma application to provide safe food for consumers.

The patented portable sterilizer PALSOO2022 is a system that fills tap water with dissolved sterilized water using a plasma generator and an atomizer nozzle to immediately convert it into sterilized water. PAW (Plasma Activated Water), which includes radicals of an oxygen meter, is acidic and has bactericidal properties against microorganisms, which makes it versatile as a disinfectant.

According to a PALSOO representative, “Plasma activated water technology is environmentally harmless, free of residual toxicity and carcinogenic by-products. Moreover, plasma active species that eliminate pests, reduce soil bacteria, and promote crop growth can be used in eco-friendly farming approaches such as smart farms, home farms (reduces bugs in apartment unit balconies), and weekend farms. It can also be used anytime in chicken farms, cattle sheds, and pigsties to reduce odors and prevent the spread of the livestock epidemic.”

They added, “In the post-COVID-19 era, the virus keeps generating variants. It is difficult to predict when the pandemic will end, and the likelihood of its prolongation is growing, requiring continued sterilization and disinfection. However, most disinfectant sprayers are not suitable for use as a refill of disinfectant solution due to the ongoing costs and inconvenience in storage. Sometimes, they're just not a viable for the purpose of being prepared ahead of time.” The representative emphasized, “Plasma wireless atomizer PALSOO, scheduled to be released in February 2023, is a social utility product that can be used in an emergency at any time, even when disinfectant solution is not readily available or ready for use.”

‘CES’ is the world’s biggest IT trade show and is a place where one can see the direction and trends of the appliance industry of the entire world. Hosted by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), it is held annually in Las Vegas, USA in January. Having reported on CES for 17 consecutive years, AVING News started reporting news of CES to the entire world since 2006, and conducted ‘BEST OF CES’, which chose the most innovative product and technology, and ‘BEST OF MADE IN KOREA, which chose the best innovative company in Korea. In addition, it vividly relayed on-site issues in CES through ‘AVING LIVE’.

The K-STARTUP Joint Pavilion featured joint participation of institutions like the Korea Institute of Startup & Entrepreneurship Development, Seoul Business Agency, and Seoul Digital Foundation, as well as 51 Korean innovative companies, to enter the US market and discover global partners. In addition, university student supporters of CES 2023 chosen by each university (Kyunghee, Kookmin, Sogang, Chung-Ang) matched to participating companies based on their respective majors and fields of business.
